package com.timetrackingreminder.runelite.farming;

/**
 * An enumeration of possible autoweed settings.
 */
enum Autoweed
{
	/**
	 * Access to autoweed has not been unlocked.
	 */
	UNOWNED,
	/**
	 * Autoweed is disabled.
	 */
	OFF,
	/**
	 * Autoweed is enabled.
	 */
	ON
}
